say:1:1330239201:1.text: Indeed... Young lives fade quickly like beautiful flowers, while old folks like me endure year after year...
say:1:1330239201:1.source_cn: 是啊……年轻的生命总是像漂亮的花一样，容易凋谢，像我这...
